shots.caption: The Databases tab: each provider with its databases, their release and an update button.
An address tried out with any provider: country, flags, coordinates, time zone, network and its logo.
MaxMind: the account ID and the licence key, typed in a masked field and kept out of the database with a constant if you prefer.
MaxMind: the GeoLite databases, and the GeoIP ones a paid account covers, each checked every day.
DB-IP: no account, tick the Lite databases to download and save.
IPinfo: the access token and IPinfo Lite, updated every day.
The provider answering the other plugins when they name none: by default, the first one with databases in place.
WooCommerce located with the databases of the plugin, instead of its own MaxMind integration.
The logos of the networks, downloaded once by the server and served from the uploads of the site.
